messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I don’t have access to live clocks, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the current time in New York City, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock set to the “New York” time zone, or simply look at the time on a device that’s already set to Eastern Time (UTC‑5 during standard time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time).

But we can also say we don't have real-time. We can provide approximate. But maybe we can use a function? There's no function for current time. We could use a function to get sunrise/sunset but not current time. So we should respond that we cannot provide real-time. We can give approximate based on UTC. But better to say we don't have real-time. Provide instructions.
